listed_quote.quote: Standard Class and Service Class shares of beneficial interest, no par value, of LVIP Blended Mid Cap Managed Volatility Fund, one series of the Registrant.

announcement.quote: Proposal 1: To approve the Plan of Reorganization with respect to the Reorganization of the LVIP VIP Mid Cap Managed Volatility Portfolio into the Acquiring Fund

deals.notes: Series of an insurance-dedicated trust (Lincoln Variable Insurance Products Trust, CIK 914036 is the registrant, hence role other); sold to separate accounts, not exchange-listed. The acquiring fund is called only 'the Acquiring Fund' in the excerpt; its name is taken from the registered-securities line of the same filing. A later PRE 14A/DEF 14A (2016-09 and 2016-10) proposes liquidating the Standard Class of the LVIP VIP Mid Cap Managed Volatility Portfolio; whether the reorganization happened is not stated.
